title: Parliament Ki Special Sitting: Delimitation Aur Women's Quota Par Fir Chhidi Bahas
summary: Center ne November 30 se Parliament ki special sitting bulayi hai, jisse Delimitation Bill aur Women's Reservation Bill ke paas hone ki fir se charcha tez ho gayi hai.
key_points: Lok Sabha 30 November aur Rajya Sabha 2 December se shuru hogi, jo 3 December tak chal sakti hai.
April mein Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill 2-thirds majority na milne ki wajah se haar gaya tha.
Government is bill ke zariye Lok Sabha seats ko 543 se badhakar 850 karna chahti hai.
Opposition parties ne short notice aur is legislative approach par sawal uthaye hain.
body: Central government ne essential government business ke liye Parliament ki special sittings bulayi hain. Lok Sabha ki baithak 30 November se aur Rajya Sabha ki baithak 2 December se shuru hogi, jo 3 December tak chal sakti hai. Is kadam ke baad ek baar fir se Delimitation Bill aur Women's Reservation Bill ko lekar political discussions tez ho gaye hain.

April mein Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill Lok Sabha mein paas hone mein nakaam raha tha kyunki government zaruri two-thirds majority hasil nahi kar paayi thi. Is amendment ke sath hi Delimitation Bill aur Union Territories Laws Amendment Bill bhi jude hue hain. Is proposal ka maksad Lok Sabha ki maximum strength ko 543 se badhakar 850 karna hai, jisse 2029 ke elections se pehle 33 percent women reservation laagu kiya ja sake.

NDA ke paas abhi Lok Sabha mein lagbhag 298 MPs hain, aur kuch rebel TMC MPs aur Shiromani Akali Dal ke support se yeh tally 319 tak pahunch sakti hai. Two-thirds majority ke liye aur bhi regional parties ke support ki zarurat pad sakti hai, jise lekar political calculations fir se shuru ho gayi hain.

Dusri taraf, Opposition parties ne is achanak bulayi gayi special sitting par sharp criticism kiya hai. Congress aur doosri party ke leaders ka kehna hai ki yeh regular Winter Session ka substitute nahi ho sakta aur iski timing par bhi sawal uthaye gaye hain. Southern states ki taraf se bhi population-based delimitation par pehle chinta jatayi ja chuki hai.
why_it_matters: Yeh khabar aam logon ke liye zaroori hai kyunki isse desh ke electoral map aur women reservation se jude bade badlavon par asar padega. Lok Sabha seats badhne aur naye delimitation se aane wale elections mein representation ka tarika poori tarah badal sakta hai.
